evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive establishes an ongoing cadence (present) while the second sentence generalizes a conditional principle about unrehearsed rollbacks (irrealis, abstract).
Labels a planned recurring event — a scheduled future activity tied to a named artifact (Atlas), concrete and irrealis as a plan.
Assigns a current role to a named individual — present attention on a concrete person.
